prompt: Children should be taught how to manage their own use of digital devices rather than having strict limits imposed by their parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that children should be taught to manage their own use of digital devices rather than having strict limits imposed by their parents. However, I personally agree with this view because it can develop children's self-control and help them become more responsible.

The primary reason why I agree with this view is that it can develop children's self-control. This is mainly because children can learn when and how long they should use digital devices instead of always depending on their parents to control them. In other words, they can gradually learn to make sensible decisions about their screen time. For example, parents can teach their children to finish their homework before using a smartphone and to stop using it after a certain period. As a result, children can develop better self-discipline and control their own digital habits. Therefore, teaching children to manage their own device use can be beneficial.

Furthermore, another important reason why I agree with this view is that it can help children become more responsible. This is because they have to make their own decisions and understand the consequences of using digital devices excessively. For instance, a child who learns to limit their own screen time may choose to put their phone away when it is time to study or sleep. Consequently, children can become more responsible for their daily activities and develop useful habits for the future. Therefore, I strongly agree with this view.

In conclusion, I firmly agree with the view that children should be taught to manage their own use of digital devices rather than having strict limits imposed by their parents. This is mainly because it can develop children's self-control and help them become more responsible.
